candidate.answerReason: Four equal portions of two pieces account for all eight pieces, so each portion contains two.

methods.label: Equal portions
methods.explanation: \(8\div4=2\). Each portion is \(\frac{1}{4}\) of the candy, which is 2 pieces.
methods.levelReason: The method uses an elementary division fact and the meaning of a quarter share, both below the grade-5 ceiling.
